comparator.sourceNotes: VU Notarieel Recht, Dutch three-year bachelor, Fall-2026 entrant; no formal route (OER10.2). The 2026–2027 OER adopted 4 June 2026, PDF generated 19 June 2026, governs. Its article15.2 explicitly applies the revised later-year curriculum to this entering cohort: use Year1 2026–27 and Year2/3 tables headed per studiejaar2027–2028. The 2028–29 transition moves ErfrechtII and Notariële ambtsuitoefening to Year3 and changes periods; it does not alter credits. Older-cohort tables and their Capita Selecta, BedrijfseconomieII, Case Studies Belastingrecht and EncyclopediaII must not be mixed into this plan. All31 compulsory components total180EC: Year1 eleven60, Year2 ten60, Year3 ten60. No free/minor space (2.2.1c,12.1,12.2). PPI1 is integrated in Juridische vaardigheden; PPI2 in Bestuursrecht, with credit/grade gates and no extra EC. Dutch diagnostic or required refresher pass gates Legal Skills; three test opportunities annually. Thesis6EC entry:120EC including Legal Skills; pleading6EC entry:99EC including Legal Skills. Administrative law requires its basics; contracts introductory obligations; inheritanceI/II and property introductory property; criminal material/procedure criminal basics; relationship property family and property; extended propertyB property. Practical attendance normally required, subject to course manual/Canvas; noncompliance excludes assessment and resit. First-year BSA42EC. Optional notarial conflict resolution is a choice within pleading, not a formal degree route or extra credit. Honours is outside180EC. The bachelor does not by itself confer notarial professional eligibility: further master and professional requirements apply.

programmes.label: Notarieel Recht at Vrije Universiteit Amsterdam

exception.reason: The workbook supports genuine comparative legal study: law and society, human rights, criminal justice, public international law, comparative constitutional/administrative law, private law and transnational business law. All eight law-focused courses together account for60EC in the proposed180EC programme. Principles of Private Law studies selected property, tort and contract principles primarily through Germany, France, England, China and the USA; Transnational Business Law addresses cross-border transactions, contracts, trade, intellectual property, investment, digital commerce and arbitration. Neither supplies the sustained Dutch property, inheritance, family/relationship-property, company and tax-law progression, notarial office law, civil/insolvency procedure and integrated Dutch legal research that define VU Notarieel Recht (OER10.3). The remaining120EC provide business, economics, statistics, rhetoric, negotiation and personal development. Accounting can support the business-economics element; negotiation and rhetoric can support communication. Public Economics studies taxation as economic policy, not Dutch tax doctrine; general research methods and market research do not supply the required independent notarial legal research. These are useful contributions but cannot replace the missing defining substance. A broader law/business/negotiation programme is a different target. The no-match conclusion concerns academic substance and weight, independently of professional eligibility or automatic master admission. A workbook-wide title/discipline/profile search found no additional notarial/property/inheritance/family/tax-law sequence from which to reconstruct a defensible response.

audience.programmeDescription: VU Notarial Law develops legal analysis and preventive advice about property, family, inheritance and business relationships. Students build a broad legal foundation before advanced Dutch private and tax law, notarial practice, pleading and an independent legal thesis.
audience.comparisonExplanation: UCR offers valuable study of comparative law, private law, European and international law, business and negotiation. These courses do not form a complete programme with the Dutch notarial, property, inheritance, family and tax-law depth that defines this degree. We therefore show the verified VU curriculum without presenting a UCR programme as a comparable alternative.

curriculum.limitation: All 180 EC are compulsory. This plan follows the revised later-year curriculum for students entering in 2026. There is no minor space. Professional identity and Dutch language testing are integrated credit or grade requirements. Thesis entry requires 120 EC including Legal Skills; pleading requires 99 EC including Legal Skills. Course prerequisites and attendance rules apply. Further study and professional training are required for notarial qualification.
